purpose: Fixed report fields for each independent simulated participant. Replace placeholders with your own observations; do not infer unseen success.
persona: Your assigned beginner persona; explicitly simulated
piece_name: Chosen project title, or null if unnamed

ratings.easy_to_use: Integer1–5; higher means more of this quality; higher confusion is worse
ratings.how_cool_it_looks: Integer1–5; higher means more of this quality; higher confusion is worse
ratings.how_fast_it_is: Integer1–5; higher means more of this quality; higher confusion is worse
ratings.how_confusing_it_is: Integer1–5; higher means more of this quality; higher confusion is worse
ratings.feature_completeness: Integer1–5; higher means more of this quality; higher confusion is worse

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Brief observed reason for this rating
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: Brief observed reason for this rating
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Brief observed reason for this rating
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Brief observed reason for this rating
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: Brief observed reason for this rating

findings.observation: Observed action and visible result, without assuming hidden implementation
evidence: Screenshot filename or mouse log timestamp

outcome.status: Completed, partial, or blocked; describe what the UI established
outcome.composition: Brief description of audio and MIDI arrangement
outcome.playback_observed: Visible playhead/meter behavior and any failures; do not equate meters with heard audio

limitations: No file contents or heard audio claim unless actually verified; independent coordinator verification follows.
